facts.business: ICICI Bank Limited is a banking company providing financial services including loans, deposits, mobile banking (iMobile), and business banking (InstaBIZ) in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex investments in specific technologies to improve environmental and social impacts (energy efficient ACs, Diesel Generator sets, chillers, solar energy equipment, BIFMA certified furniture, GreenPro certified physical security elements)

key_risks: Identification of non-performing advances (NPA) and related provisioning involves judgement and estimation
Compliance with RBI IRAC norms for asset classification and provisioning
Collateral valuation and recovery estimates for NPA provisioning
